capabilities: Pull unchecked tasks from earlier daily or weekly notes into the current note
Remove moved tasks from the notes they came from
Move indented sub-tasks and notes along with their parent task
Pull unfinished sub-tasks out from under finished tasks as top-level tasks
Configure the weekly note name format when Periodic Notes and Calendar are absent
extras: The README warns that undo removes the pulled tasks from the current note but does not restore them to the earlier notes. It also includes maintainer-facing release instructions.
motivation: The README says yesterday's open tasks shouldn't get forgotten and old notes shouldn't pile up with duplicates.
problem: Open tasks in past daily and weekly notes get forgotten or get duplicated when users copy them forward by hand.

relations.evidence: Leftovers uses the folder and date format from Obsidian's core Daily Notes plugin, or from Periodic Notes
With Periodic Notes or Calendar: Leftovers uses that plugin's weekly note folder and format.

summary: Task carry-over plugin that moves unfinished checkboxes from earlier daily or weekly notes into the note you are working on.
